problem_summary: 8 citizen complaints about 'Fixing/Reparing Potholes' were recorded in Hagadur between March 2019 and January 2021, spanning 3 calendar year(s). 38% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened).

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

agency_attribution_note: 8 of 8 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier MEDIUM (score=0.44). Top scoring factors: recurrence_years=1.00, unresolved_rate=0.38, description_severity=0.36.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='Hagadur' not found in name crosswalk (one of the 15 unmatched wards). No enrichment applied.
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for Hagadur for the period 2019–2021.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.
